title: Replace an explosives, pyrotechnician or blasting licence, or security clearance card
summary: You can apply for a replacement security clearance card or an explosives, pyrotechnicians or blasting licence card or certificate if your existing licence is lost, stolen, damaged, or has a printing error.
intro: You can apply for a replacement security clearance card or an explosives, pyrotechnicians or blasting licence card (for individuals) or certificate (for corporations), if there has been a printing error, the licence has not been received or is lost, stolen, damaged or destroyed.
what_you_need: Your existing licence or authorisation number
Your reason for requesting a replacement

how_to_steps.text: Complete the form and submit your application with payment.

more_info.text: Visit Verify NSW to look up and check a NSW licence or registration.

faqs.q: What types of licences can I get a replacement for?
faqs.a: You can apply for a replacement security clearance card or an explosives, pyrotechnicians or blasting licence card (for individuals) or certificate (for corporations).

faqs.q: Why would I need a replacement licence?
faqs.a: You may need a replacement if there has been a printing error, the licence has not been received, or if it is lost, stolen, damaged, or destroyed.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a replacement licence?
faqs.a: Select the 'Apply online' button, complete the form, and submit your application with payment.
